title: session.reading@2
description: A reading the hub takes of a session: something about it a person should see beside it, such as that it works in one of DeepBuild's job folders or resumed a job's session ID. A minor of session.reading@1 (#1456): its code beside its words, so what a reading does to its session's state is read from the code and never from the words. It changes nothing about how the session is judged.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

reading.description: The reading, in words, naming what it is about.

code.description: What the reading is, which its session's state reads: its hooks can't run or can again, its holds only watch, a call DeepBuild denied ran anyway, its home loads a mod that overrides the guard or no longer does, a heavy command ran unleased, a stop not held, it waits on its monitor or its monitor ended, a turn you interrupted, it runs the older or the current synced set, or any other reading.

x-closure.closed: the readings a session's state or row reads
x-closure.reopens: a minor that adds a reading a state reads
